chunks: Say: "O people, act as best you can on your part, I am acting too. You will come to know in time"

key_terms.فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ: Then you will come to know

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'act on your station' mean in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *tawqif* (divine timing) and the distinct roles of the Prophet and his community, emphasizing that while humans strive according to their station, the ultimate outcome is revealed by Allah at the appointed time. It serves as a reassurance to the faithful that their efforts are recognized even if the results are not immediately apparent, a concept often linked to the patience required during the occultation of the Imam. The verse highlights the dynamic between human agency and divine decree, encouraging steadfastness in worship and leadership.
